sections.Description:
The taunting is over and the haunting begins in the third and campiest installment of the Elvira pinball trilogy!

Trying to sell her mansion through “Alternate Realty”, Elvira’s house is haunted by the movie characters from her past. These ghouls, ghosts, monsters, and strange assortment of vintage characters with horrific acting skills seek revenge on Elvira while she and the player confront them, sending them back to the “film” from which they came!
sections.Gameplay Features:
- The House of Horrors: A frightening Victorian fixer-upper, full of creepy charm and supernatural surprises. Players can gain access to the mansion through the front door, the cellar, or through the garage which is guarded by a gravestone drop-target.
- Deadhead Family Crypt: This mausoleum houses a variety of characters that need an awakening awakenin courtesy of a steel silver ball to their head. This interactive crypt will keep players on their toes with the Crypt entrance unleashing balls from a separate location while also becoming a physical bash toy.
- Junk in the Trunk: Elvira’s pending move from her hopeful home sale, the interactive trunk toy allows players to lock balls for a frantic two-ball multiball.
